{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows with baseline biomarker = -999 (QC failure)
valid_baseline = df["biomarker_baseline"] != -999
df = df[valid_baseline].copy()

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient_id
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df = df.sort_values(by=["patient_id", "sample_seq"], ascending=[True, False])
df = df.drop_duplicates(subset="patient_id", keep="first")

# Step 3: Correct assay_batch B values (convert µg/L to ng/mL)
# Batch B is 10× too high: divide by 10
df.loc[df["assay_batch"] == "B", "biomarker_final"] /= 10

# Step 4: Compute change in biomarker (final - baseline)
df["biomarker_change"] = df["biomarker_final"] - df["biomarker_baseline"]

# Step 5: Compute average change
avg_change = df["biomarker_change"].mean()

print(f'Final sample size after filtering and deduplication: {len(df)}')
print(f'Average biomarker change: {avg_change:.2f} ng/mL')

# Return the result for submission
avg_change"}
